notes: Ten movable-part episodes are identified. The upper cabinet above the sink appears to have two independently hinged leaves; they are reported separately as required, although the 8-frame sampling makes their exact opening and closing order somewhat ambiguous. Open is treated as the on state and closed as the off state.
